cases.rationale: The synopsis gives response rate its revised rank alongside the existing co-primary endpoints.
The worksheet preserves eligibility and offers the extension as a choice.
Either trigger on its own could release the analysis before the amended conditions are met.
cases.correction: Require both conditions and retain the last enrolment as the start of the follow-up clock.

cases.rationale: The site keeps the two-year stopping option and leaves the decision open.
Death before another intervention contributes an event under the revised definition.
Sites could order a research procedure that this amendment removed.
cases.correction: Remove the optional study KRAS order from this manual.

cases.rationale: All entrants at German sites are covered, and the claim is confined to that amendment.
The form removes the progression hurdle and leaves other conditions in place.
The schedule would add repeat assessments for participants already at stage 5 at baseline.
cases.correction: Limit interval reassessment to those below stage 5 at the initial assessment.

cases.rationale: The checklist could turn away a candidate who should still be assessed.
cases.correction: Remove the automatic screen failure for lamotrigine alone.

cases.rationale: Using age in completed years, 15 or younger is the same boundary as under 16.
The worksheet bypasses eligibility and treats an available crossover as an automatic transfer.
cases.correction: Check crossover eligibility and describe entry as an option.

cases.rationale: A site would discard survival information that the amendment allows it to collect.
cases.correction: Allow out-of-window supplementary survival data while preserving the scheduled visits.

cases.rationale: A site following this draft would take a choice away from patients who could continue treatment.
cases.correction: Make stopping optional for Arm A patients who reach two years without progression or unacceptable toxicity.

cases.rationale: Additional survival information can be recorded outside the usual schedule.
A 16-year-old would be assigned a scale intended here for the younger group.
cases.correction: Set the Lansky threshold to under 16, in completed years.

cases.rationale: The synopsis would give a primary measure the wrong standing.
cases.correction: Identify objective response rate as an additional co-primary endpoint.

cases.rationale: The checklist exports a German requirement to sites outside that amendment’s scope.
cases.correction: Limit this amendment-specific instruction to German sites. Check other sites against their own requirements.

cases.rationale: The schedule distinguishes the initial assessment from the subgroup needing repeats.
The analysis would treat a defined endpoint event as a censored observation.
cases.correction: Count death as an event in the time-to-next-intervention analysis.

cases.rationale: The checklist requires both the event target and the follow-up minimum measured from last enrolment.
The checklist removes this single exclusion while keeping the rest of screening intact.
The lab menu removes the study-specific order without making a claim about routine care.
The form would block requests on a condition the amendment removed.
cases.correction: Remove the mandatory progression-documentation field as a gate to crossover.
